Problem Statement:
Given an array, for each element find the value of nearest element to the right which is having frequency greater than as that of current element using  Stack . If there does not exist an answer for a position, then make the value '-1'.
input_spec:
First line N indicates the size of the array.
Second line indicates elements of the array
